summary: Turn your Kobo into a remote control for your computer. Needs your computer.
page_description: Pair with your computer and run favorite actions from large, clear controls.
release_notes: Pads sent from your computer while Deck shows the pairing steps now appear straight away, and a pad in the preview no longer offers to run on a computer that is not paired.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.
In your project folder on the computer, lay out your first pads. Change them later with kobo deck set.
Pair this computer with the reader. There is nothing to type on the reader. The first time, close Cobalt and open it again afterwards.
Start the helper and leave it running, then open Deck on the reader.
